history.summary: Older (2000) 99LH 3BR steps from the new Sungei Bedok MRT interchange (190m), $1.86M / $1,339 psf — exactly at the URA median ($1,335) with a healthy resale-only 5.6%/yr appreciation. The standout is genuine interchange-adjacency (DTL + TEL/future) in the Bayshore growth precinct, offset by a ~74-year remaining lease and a large 1,389 sqft unit.
history.rating_rationale: 190m to Sungei Bedok MRT (Downtown Line terminus, future Thomson-East Coast interchange) is a top-tier connectivity catalyst in D16's Bayshore transformation zone, and the resale-only 5.6%/yr CAGR is strong for OCR/D16. Priced at the median ($1,339 vs $1,335) so no overpay. Caveats: built 2000 = ~74 yrs lease left (financing/depreciation pressure as it ages) and 1,389 sqft is large, but the location premium and proven appreciation justify a Buy. 14 txns is modest but acceptable.
red_flags: ~74-year remaining lease (2000 build) — lease decay accelerates over a 5–7yr hold
Only 14 URA transactions — appreciation rate moderately reliable
catalysts: 190m to Sungei Bedok MRT — DTL terminus and future TEL interchange
Bayshore precinct redevelopment and Bedok/Upper East Coast growth
Resale-only appreciation 5.6%/yr, priced at URA median
